"""Java slice conformance (docs/java.md): identity, kinds, provenance, package, type and
member resolution, tests, cached facts and persisted incremental/full-rebuild equality."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from conftest import REPO, write
from test_go import unresolved
from test_incremental import BAD, _paths, _replace, apply, dump
from test_typescript import derived, resolved

import oxide
from oxide.capture import capture
from oxide.core.indexing import derive, dialect, validate
from oxide.core.languages import java, python

FIXTURE = REPO / "fixtures/java_repo"
MAIN = "src/main/java/com/example/shop"
STORE = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store/Store.java#Store"
CART = f"symbol:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java#Cart"
TEST = "symbol:src/test/java/com/example/shop/store/StoreTest.java#StoreTest"


def test_fixture_entities_kinds_and_provenance() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    files = {f.path: f for f in found.files}
    assert all(
        f.language == "java" and f.coverage == "complete"
        for f in found.files
        if f.path.endswith(".java")
    )
    assert files["pom.xml"].coverage == "unsupported"
    entities = {e.key: e for e in found.entities}
    kinds = {k: e.kind for k, e in entities.items() if e.category == "symbol"}
    store = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store"
    assert kinds[STORE] == "class"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend"] == "interface"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.getOrDefault"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key"] == "record"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key.Key"] == "constructor"  # compact
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode"] == "enum"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached"] == "annotation"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached.seconds"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Entry.value"] == "method"  # nested under its class
    # Overloads take source-order ordinals; constructors are named by their class.
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.put~1"] == kinds[f"{STORE}.put"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Store~1"] == "constructor"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.put~1"].name == "put"
    # Members of anonymous classes and enum constant bodies are not symbols.
    assert f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label~1" not in kinds
    assert f"{CART}.run" not in kinds and f"{CART}.listen.run" not in kinds
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"].test
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.labelsWrites"].test  # a qualified @Test
    assert not entities[f"{TEST}.fixture"].test
    modules = {e.key: e.name for e in found.entities if e.category == "module"}
    assert modules == {
        f"module:java:com.example.shop.{p}": f"com.example.shop.{p}"
        for p in ("cart", "store", "util")
    }  # Main.java is in the default package: no module
    data = {f.path: f.data for f in capture(FIXTURE).files}
    for key, start, end in [
        (STORE, "@Cached\npublic class Store", "\n}\n"),
        (f"{STORE}.get", "@Override\n    public String get", "entry.value();\n    }"),
        (f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get", "String get(Key key);", "String get(Key key);"),
    ]:
        source = entities[key].source
        assert source is not None and source.digest == files[source.path].digest
        text = data[source.path][source.start : source.end].decode()
        assert text.startswith(start) and text.endswith(end), key  # annotations, no Javadoc
    signature = entities[STORE].signature
    assert signature == "public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.get"].signature == "public String get(Key key)"


def test_fixture_relations() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    store, util = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store", f"symbol:{MAIN}/util/Strings.java#Strings"
    assert resolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "module:java:com.example.shop.store",  # on demand
        util,
    }
    assert unresolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "java.util.ArrayList",
        "java.util.List",
        "javax.swing.JPanel",
    }
    # A static import of an overloaded method names every overload.
    assert {e.targets for e in found.edges if e.name == "com.example.shop.util.Strings.join"} == {
        (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get") == {
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore.normalize",  # inherited
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get",  # a field's declared type
        f"{STORE}.Entry.value",  # a local's declared type, a member type
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{STORE}.get"}  # this.get
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.put~1") == {f"{STORE}.put"}  # by arity
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.open") == {
        STORE,  # new Store()
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key",
        f"{STORE}.put",
        f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label",
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.add") == {
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key.of",  # a static method through an on-demand import
        f"{STORE}.put",  # a field of a type from that import
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.describe") == {f"{util}.join", f"{CART}.names"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.Summary.text") == {f"{CART}.describe"}  # outer
    # Anonymous classes, external supertypes and implicit members could declare the
    # name, so it stays unresolved; so do calls on external types.
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.listen") == {"new Runnable", "later.run", "describe"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.View.refresh") == {"describe", "repaint"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode") == {"name"}
    assert "key.value" in unresolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get")  # a record accessor
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{TEST}.labelsWrites") == {f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label"}
    ambiguous = [(e.source, e.targets) for e in found.edges if e.resolution == "ambiguous"]
    assert ambiguous == [
        (f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),
        (f"{util}.join~1", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),  # both accept one
    ]
    assert resolved(found, "references", STORE) == {
        f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached",  # an annotation
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore",
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend",
        f"{STORE}.Entry",  # a type argument
    }
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{TEST}.fixture") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    defines = resolved(found, "defines", "module:java:com.example.shop.store")
    assert STORE in defines and f"{TEST}" in defines  # test sources share the package
    assert f"{STORE}.get" not in defines  # inside its class
    assert resolved(found, "contains", STORE) == {
        f"{STORE}.{m}" for m in ("Store", "Store~1", "get", "mustGet", "put", "put~1", "open")
    } | {f"{STORE}.Entry"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", "symbol:Main.java#Main.main") == {
        CART,
        STORE,
        f"{CART}.add",
        f"{CART}.describe",
    }


def test_search_and_context(tmp_path: Path, fts: Path) -> None:
    with oxide.open_repository(FIXTURE, data_dir=tmp_path / "data") as repo:
        repo.index()
        result = repo.search("mustGet store key", symbols=["mustGet"])
        assert result.entries[0].entity.key == f"{STORE}.mustGet"
        bundle = repo.build_context("open the store", symbols=["open"], budget=1024)
        assert 0 < bundle.used <= 1024
        assert "static Store open(Mode mode)" in bundle.payload


def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(T T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <f> void generic(f x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter's members
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow") == set()
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name != "a.Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert refs["c/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:c/Box.java#Box",)  # the package beats on-demand
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }


def test_identity_is_local_and_deterministic(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

"""Java slice conformance (docs/java.md): identity, kinds, provenance, package, type and
member resolution, tests, cached facts and persisted incremental/full-rebuild equality."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from conftest import REPO, write
from test_go import unresolved
from test_incremental import BAD, _paths, _replace, apply, dump
from test_typescript import derived, resolved

import oxide
from oxide.capture import capture
from oxide.core.indexing import derive, dialect, validate
from oxide.core.languages import java, python

FIXTURE = REPO / "fixtures/java_repo"
MAIN = "src/main/java/com/example/shop"
STORE = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store/Store.java#Store"
CART = f"symbol:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java#Cart"
TEST = "symbol:src/test/java/com/example/shop/store/StoreTest.java#StoreTest"


def test_fixture_entities_kinds_and_provenance() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    files = {f.path: f for f in found.files}
    assert all(
        f.language == "java" and f.coverage == "complete"
        for f in found.files
        if f.path.endswith(".java")
    )
    assert files["pom.xml"].coverage == "unsupported"
    entities = {e.key: e for e in found.entities}
    kinds = {k: e.kind for k, e in entities.items() if e.category == "symbol"}
    store = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store"
    assert kinds[STORE] == "class"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend"] == "interface"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.getOrDefault"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key"] == "record"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key.Key"] == "constructor"  # compact
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode"] == "enum"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached"] == "annotation"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached.seconds"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Entry.value"] == "method"  # nested under its class
    # Overloads take source-order ordinals; constructors are named by their class.
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.put~1"] == kinds[f"{STORE}.put"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Store~1"] == "constructor"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.put~1"].name == "put"
    # Members of anonymous classes and enum constant bodies are not symbols.
    assert f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label~1" not in kinds
    assert f"{CART}.run" not in kinds and f"{CART}.listen.run" not in kinds
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"].test
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.labelsWrites"].test  # a qualified @Test
    assert not entities[f"{TEST}.fixture"].test
    modules = {e.key: e.name for e in found.entities if e.category == "module"}
    assert modules == {
        f"module:java:com.example.shop.{p}": f"com.example.shop.{p}"
        for p in ("cart", "store", "util")
    }  # Main.java is in the default package: no module
    data = {f.path: f.data for f in capture(FIXTURE).files}
    for key, start, end in [
        (STORE, "@Cached\npublic class Store", "\n}\n"),
        (f"{STORE}.get", "@Override\n    public String get", "entry.value();\n    }"),
        (f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get", "String get(Key key);", "String get(Key key);"),
    ]:
        source = entities[key].source
        assert source is not None and source.digest == files[source.path].digest
        text = data[source.path][source.start : source.end].decode()
        assert text.startswith(start) and text.endswith(end), key  # annotations, no Javadoc
    signature = entities[STORE].signature
    assert signature == "public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.get"].signature == "public String get(Key key)"


def test_fixture_relations() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    store, util = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store", f"symbol:{MAIN}/util/Strings.java#Strings"
    assert resolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "module:java:com.example.shop.store",  # on demand
        util,
    }
    assert unresolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "java.util.ArrayList",
        "java.util.List",
        "javax.swing.JPanel",
    }
    # A static import of an overloaded method names every overload.
    assert {e.targets for e in found.edges if e.name == "com.example.shop.util.Strings.join"} == {
        (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get") == {
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore.normalize",  # inherited
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get",  # a field's declared type
        f"{STORE}.Entry.value",  # a local's declared type, a member type
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{STORE}.get"}  # this.get
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.put~1") == {f"{STORE}.put"}  # by arity
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.open") == {
        STORE,  # new Store()
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key",
        f"{STORE}.put",
        f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label",
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.add") == {
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key.of",  # a static method through an on-demand import
        f"{STORE}.put",  # a field of a type from that import
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.describe") == {f"{util}.join", f"{CART}.names"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.Summary.text") == {f"{CART}.describe"}  # outer
    # Anonymous classes, external supertypes and implicit members could declare the
    # name, so it stays unresolved; so do calls on external types.
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.listen") == {"new Runnable", "later.run", "describe"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.View.refresh") == {"describe", "repaint"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode") == {"name"}
    assert "key.value" in unresolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get")  # a record accessor
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{TEST}.labelsWrites") == {f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label"}
    ambiguous = [(e.source, e.targets) for e in found.edges if e.resolution == "ambiguous"]
    assert ambiguous == [
        (f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),
        (f"{util}.join~1", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),  # both accept one
    ]
    assert resolved(found, "references", STORE) == {
        f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached",  # an annotation
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore",
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend",
        f"{STORE}.Entry",  # a type argument
    }
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{TEST}.fixture") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    defines = resolved(found, "defines", "module:java:com.example.shop.store")
    assert STORE in defines and f"{TEST}" in defines  # test sources share the package
    assert f"{STORE}.get" not in defines  # inside its class
    assert resolved(found, "contains", STORE) == {
        f"{STORE}.{m}" for m in ("Store", "Store~1", "get", "mustGet", "put", "put~1", "open")
    } | {f"{STORE}.Entry"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", "symbol:Main.java#Main.main") == {
        CART,
        STORE,
        f"{CART}.add",
        f"{CART}.describe",
    }

def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(T T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <f> void generic(f x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter's members
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow") == set()
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name != "a.Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert refs["c/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:c/Box.java#Box",)  # the package beats on-demand
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }

"""Java slice conformance (docs/java.md): identity, kinds, provenance, package, type and
member resolution, tests, cached facts and persisted incremental/full-rebuild equality."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from conftest import REPO, write
from test_go import unresolved
from test_incremental import BAD, _paths, _replace, apply, dump
from test_typescript import derived, resolved

import oxide
from oxide.capture import capture
from oxide.core.indexing import derive, dialect, validate
from oxide.core.languages import java, python

FIXTURE = REPO / "fixtures/java_repo"
MAIN = "src/main/java/com/example/shop"
STORE = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store/Store.java#Store"
CART = f"symbol:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java#Cart"
TEST = "symbol:src/test/java/com/example/shop/store/StoreTest.java#StoreTest"


def test_fixture_entities_kinds_and_provenance() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    files = {f.path: f for f in found.files}
    assert all(
        f.language == "java" and f.coverage == "complete"
        for f in found.files
        if f.path.endswith(".java")
    )
    assert files["pom.xml"].coverage == "unsupported"
    entities = {e.key: e for e in found.entities}
    kinds = {k: e.kind for k, e in entities.items() if e.category == "symbol"}
    store = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store"
    assert kinds[STORE] == "class"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend"] == "interface"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.getOrDefault"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key"] == "record"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key.Key"] == "constructor"  # compact
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode"] == "enum"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached"] == "annotation"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached.seconds"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Entry.value"] == "method"  # nested under its class
    # Overloads take source-order ordinals; constructors are named by their class.
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.put~1"] == kinds[f"{STORE}.put"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Store~1"] == "constructor"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.put~1"].name == "put"
    # Members of anonymous classes and enum constant bodies are not symbols.
    assert f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label~1" not in kinds
    assert f"{CART}.run" not in kinds and f"{CART}.listen.run" not in kinds
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"].test
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.labelsWrites"].test  # a qualified @Test
    assert not entities[f"{TEST}.fixture"].test
    modules = {e.key: e.name for e in found.entities if e.category == "module"}
    assert modules == {
        f"module:java:com.example.shop.{p}": f"com.example.shop.{p}"
        for p in ("cart", "store", "util")
    }  # Main.java is in the default package: no module
    data = {f.path: f.data for f in capture(FIXTURE).files}
    for key, start, end in [
        (STORE, "@Cached\npublic class Store", "\n}\n"),
        (f"{STORE}.get", "@Override\n    public String get", "entry.value();\n    }"),
        (f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get", "String get(Key key);", "String get(Key key);"),
    ]:
        source = entities[key].source
        assert source is not None and source.digest == files[source.path].digest
        text = data[source.path][source.start : source.end].decode()
        assert text.startswith(start) and text.endswith(end), key  # annotations, no Javadoc
    signature = entities[STORE].signature
    assert signature == "public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.get"].signature == "public String get(Key key)"


def test_fixture_relations() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    store, util = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store", f"symbol:{MAIN}/util/Strings.java#Strings"
    assert resolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "module:java:com.example.shop.store",  # on demand
        util,
    }
    assert unresolved(found, "imports", f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java") == {
        "java.util.ArrayList",
        "java.util.List",
        "javax.swing.JPanel",
    }
    # A static import of an overloaded method names every overload.
    assert {e.targets for e in found.edges if e.name == "com.example.shop.util.Strings.join"} == {
        (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get") == {
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore.normalize",  # inherited
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get",  # a field's declared type
        f"{STORE}.Entry.value",  # a local's declared type, a member type
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{STORE}.get"}  # this.get
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.put~1") == {f"{STORE}.put"}  # by arity
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.open") == {
        STORE,  # new Store()
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key",
        f"{STORE}.put",
        f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label",
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.add") == {
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key.of",  # a static method through an on-demand import
        f"{STORE}.put",  # a field of a type from that import
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.describe") == {f"{util}.join", f"{CART}.names"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.Summary.text") == {f"{CART}.describe"}  # outer
    # Anonymous classes, external supertypes and implicit members could declare the
    # name, so it stays unresolved; so do calls on external types.
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.listen") == {"new Runnable", "later.run", "describe"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.View.refresh") == {"describe", "repaint"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode") == {"name"}
    assert "key.value" in unresolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get")  # a record accessor
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{TEST}.labelsWrites") == {f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label"}
    ambiguous = [(e.source, e.targets) for e in found.edges if e.resolution == "ambiguous"]
    assert ambiguous == [
        (f"file:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),
        (f"{util}.join~1", (f"{util}.join", f"{util}.join~1")),  # both accept one
    ]
    assert resolved(found, "references", STORE) == {
        f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached",  # an annotation
        f"{store}/AbstractStore.java#AbstractStore",
        f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend",
        f"{STORE}.Entry",  # a type argument
    }
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{STORE}.mustGet") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    assert resolved(found, "tested_by", f"{TEST}.fixture") == {f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"}
    defines = resolved(found, "defines", "module:java:com.example.shop.store")
    assert STORE in defines and f"{TEST}" in defines  # test sources share the package
    assert f"{STORE}.get" not in defines  # inside its class
    assert resolved(found, "contains", STORE) == {
        f"{STORE}.{m}" for m in ("Store", "Store~1", "get", "mustGet", "put", "put~1", "open")
    } | {f"{STORE}.Entry"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", "symbol:Main.java#Main.main") == {
        CART,
        STORE,
        f"{CART}.add",
        f"{CART}.describe",
    }


def test_search_and_context(tmp_path: Path, fts: Path) -> None:
    with oxide.open_repository(FIXTURE, data_dir=tmp_path / "data") as repo:
        repo.index()
        result = repo.search("mustGet store key", symbols=["mustGet"])
        assert result.entries[0].entity.key == f"{STORE}.mustGet"
        bundle = repo.build_context("open the store", symbols=["open"], budget=1024)
        assert 0 < bundle.used <= 1024
        assert "static Store open(Mode mode)" in bundle.payload


def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(T T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <f> void generic(f x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter's members
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow") == set()
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name != "a.Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert refs["c/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:c/Box.java#Box",)  # the package beats on-demand
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }


def test_identity_is_local_and_deterministic(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    files = {"A.java": "class A { void f() {} void f(int x) {} class B { void f() {} } }\n"}
    first = derived(write(tmp_path / "one", files))
    second = derived(write(tmp_path / "two", {**files, "C.java": "class C { void f() {} }\n"}))
    keys = {e.key for e in first.entities}
    assert {"symbol:A.java#A.f", "symbol:A.java#A.f~1", "symbol:A.java#A.B.f"} <= keys
    assert keys <= {e.key for e in second.entities}
    assert derived(tmp_path / "one") == first
    assert dialect("src/X.java") == "java" and dialect("X.jav") is None


def test_coverage_cache_validation_and_limits(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path,
        {
            "Ok.java": "class Ok { void ok() {} }\n",
            "Broken.java": "class Broken { void broken( { return; }\n void after() {} }\n",
            "Latin.java": b"class Latin { } // \xff\n",
        },
    )
    full = derived(root)
    files = {f.path: f for f in full.files}
    assert files["Broken.java"].coverage == "partial" and files["Broken.java"].diagnostics
    assert files["Latin.java"].coverage == "unsupported"
    assert "symbol:Broken.java#Broken" in {e.key for e in full.entities}
    assert set(full.facts) == {"java"}
    for f in capture(root).files:
        parsed = java.parse(f.data)
        if not isinstance(parsed, str):
            assert java.decode(json.loads(json.dumps(java.encode(parsed))), len(f.data)) == parsed
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", full.facts).reused == 2
    cached = copy.deepcopy(full.facts)
    for key in cached["java"]:
        cached["java"][key] = ["damaged"]
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", cached) == full
    deep = ("class P { int x = " + "(" * 70000 + "1" + ")" * 70000 + "; }\n").encode()
    assert java.parse(deep) == python.TOO_DEEP


def test_unsound_cached_facts_are_parsed_never_trusted_or_fatal(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.open") == {
        STORE,  # new Store()
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key",
        f"{STORE}.put",
        f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label",
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.add") == {
        f"{store}/Key.java#Key.of",  # a static method through an on-demand import
        f"{STORE}.put",  # a field of a type from that import
    }
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.describe") == {f"{util}.join", f"{CART}.names"}
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.Summary.text") == {f"{CART}.describe"}  # outer
    # Anonymous classes, external supertypes and implicit members could declare the
    # name, so it stays unresolved; so do calls on external types.
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.listen") == {"new Runnable", "later.run", "describe"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{CART}.View.refresh") == {"describe", "repaint"}
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode") == {"name"}
    assert "key.value" in unresolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.get")  # a record accessor

    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{TEST}.labelsWrites") == {f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label"}

    assert STORE in defines and TEST in defines  # test sources share the package
    assert f"{STORE}.get" not in defines  # inside its class

def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(Object T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <U extends T> void generic(U x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow")
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name == "Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Demand.java#Demand") == {
        "symbol:c/Box.java#Box"  # the package beats on-demand imports
    }
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }


def test_identity_is_local_and_deterministic(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    files = {"A.java": "class A { void f() {} void f(int x) {} class B { void f() {} } }\n"}
    first = derived(write(tmp_path / "one", files))
    second = derived(write(tmp_path / "two", {**files, "C.java": "class C { void f() {} }\n"}))
    keys = {e.key for e in first.entities}
    assert {"symbol:A.java#A.f", "symbol:A.java#A.f~1", "symbol:A.java#A.B.f"} <= keys
    assert keys <= {e.key for e in second.entities}
    assert derived(tmp_path / "one") == first
    assert dialect("src/X.java") == "java" and dialect("X.jav") is None


def test_coverage_cache_validation_and_limits(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path,
        {
            "Ok.java": "class Ok { void ok() {} }\n",
            "Broken.java": "class Broken { void broken( { return; }\n void after() {} }\n",
            "Latin.java": b"class Latin { } // \xff\n",
        },
    )
    full = derived(root)
    files = {f.path: f for f in full.files}
    assert files["Broken.java"].coverage == "partial" and files["Broken.java"].diagnostics
    assert files["Latin.java"].coverage == "unsupported"
    assert "symbol:Broken.java#Broken" in {e.key for e in full.entities}
    assert set(full.facts) == {"java"}
    for f in capture(root).files:
        parsed = java.parse(f.data)
        if not isinstance(parsed, str):
            assert java.decode(json.loads(json.dumps(java.encode(parsed))), len(f.data)) == parsed
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", full.facts).reused == 2
    cached = copy.deepcopy(full.facts)
    for key in cached["java"]:
        cached["java"][key] = ["damaged"]
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", cached) == full
    deep = ("class P { int x = " + "(" * 70000 + "1" + ")" * 70000 + "; }\n").encode()
    assert java.parse(deep) == python.TOO_DEEP


def test_unsound_cached_facts_are_parsed_never_trusted_or_fatal(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source = (
        "package p;\nimport static q.R.s;\nimport q.*;\n"
        "class A<T> extends B implements C {\n  int n = 1;\n"
        "  void m(D d, int... xs) { d.go(1); this.m(d); new E() { void r() {} }; }\n"
        "  @Test void t() {}\n  enum F { G { }, H }\n}\n"
    )
    snapshot = capture(write(tmp_path / "repo", {"p/A.java": source}))
    full = derive(snapshot, "r")
    ((key, good),) = full.facts["java"].items()
    size = len(snapshot.files[0].data)
    rejected = 0
    for at in _paths(good):
        for bad in BAD:
            entry = _replace(good, at, bad)
            try:
                java.decode(entry, size)
            except ValueError:
                rejected += 1
                result = derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}})
                assert result == full and result.reused == 0, (at, bad)
                continue
            # Well-formed facts parse could have produced: they may differ, never fail.
            validate(derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}}))
    assert rejected > len(_paths(good)) * len(BAD) // 2


def test_persisted_incremental_equals_full_rebuild(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path / "repo",
        {
            "a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n",
            "b/B.java": "package b;\nimport a.A;\nclass B { void b() { A.go(); } }\n",
        },
    )
    steps: list[dict[str, str | bytes | None]] = [
        {"a/More.java": "package a;\nclass More extends A { void more() { go(); } }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go(int x) {} }\n"},
        {"a/More.java": None, "b/BTest.java": "package b;\nclass BTest { @Test void t() {} }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package renamed;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n"},
    ]
    with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / "incremental") as repo:
        repo.index()
        for i, edits in enumerate(steps):
            apply(root, edits)
            report = repo.index()
            assert report.reused >= 1
            with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / f"full-{i}") as fresh:
                fresh.index()
                assert dump(repo) == dump(fresh)

"""Java slice conformance (docs/java.md): identity, kinds, provenance, package, type and
member resolution, tests, cached facts and persisted incremental/full-rebuild equality."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from conftest import REPO, write
from test_go import unresolved
from test_incremental import BAD, _paths, _replace, apply, dump
from test_typescript import derived, resolved

import oxide
from oxide.capture import capture
from oxide.core.indexing import derive, dialect, validate
from oxide.core.languages import java, python

FIXTURE = REPO / "fixtures/java_repo"
MAIN = "src/main/java/com/example/shop"
STORE = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store/Store.java#Store"
CART = f"symbol:{MAIN}/cart/Cart.java#Cart"
TEST = "symbol:src/test/java/com/example/shop/store/StoreTest.java#StoreTest"


def test_fixture_entities_kinds_and_provenance() -> None:
    found = derived(FIXTURE)
    files = {f.path: f for f in found.files}
    assert all(
        f.language == "java" and f.coverage == "complete"
        for f in found.files
        if f.path.endswith(".java")
    )
    assert files["pom.xml"].coverage == "unsupported"
    entities = {e.key: e for e in found.entities}
    kinds = {k: e.kind for k, e in entities.items() if e.category == "symbol"}
    store = f"symbol:{MAIN}/store"
    assert kinds[STORE] == "class"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend"] == "interface"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.getOrDefault"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key"] == "record"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Key.java#Key.Key"] == "constructor"  # compact
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode"] == "enum"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached"] == "annotation"
    assert kinds[f"{store}/Cached.java#Cached.seconds"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Entry.value"] == "method"  # nested under its class
    # Overloads take source-order ordinals; constructors are named by their class.
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.put~1"] == kinds[f"{STORE}.put"] == "method"
    assert kinds[f"{STORE}.Store~1"] == "constructor"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.put~1"].name == "put"
    # Members of anonymous classes and enum constant bodies are not symbols.
    assert f"{store}/Mode.java#Mode.label~1" not in kinds
    assert not any(k.endswith(".run") for k in kinds)
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.getsWhatWasPut"].test
    assert entities[f"{TEST}.labelsWrites"].test  # a qualified @Test
    assert not entities[f"{TEST}.fixture"].test
    modules = {e.key: e.name for e in found.entities if e.category == "module"}
    assert modules == {
        f"module:java:com.example.shop.{p}": f"com.example.shop.{p}"
        for p in ("cart", "store", "util")
    }  # Main.java is in the default package: no module
    data = {f.path: f.data for f in capture(FIXTURE).files}
    for key, start, end in [
        (STORE, "@Cached\npublic class Store", "\n}"),
        (f"{STORE}.get", "@Override\n    public String get", "entry.value();\n    }"),
        (f"{store}/Backend.java#Backend.get", "String get(Key key);", "String get(Key key);"),
    ]:
        source = entities[key].source
        assert source is not None and source.digest == files[source.path].digest
        text = data[source.path][source.start : source.end].decode()
        assert text.startswith(start) and text.endswith(end), key  # annotations, no Javadoc
    signature = entities[STORE].signature
    assert signature == "public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend"
    assert entities[f"{STORE}.get"].signature == "public String get(Key key)"

    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.put~1") == {f"{STORE}.put"}  # by arity
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{STORE}.open") == {

def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(Object T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <U extends T> void generic(U x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow")
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name == "Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Demand.java#Demand") == {
        "symbol:c/Box.java#Box"  # the package beats on-demand imports
    }
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }

    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", full.facts).reused == 2

def test_unsound_cached_facts_are_parsed_never_trusted_or_fatal(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source = (
        "package p;\nimport static q.R.s;\nimport q.*;\n"
        "class A<T> extends B implements C {\n  int n = 1;\n"
        "  void m(D d, int... xs) { d.go(1); this.m(d); new E() { void r() {} }; }\n"
        "  @Test void t() {}\n  enum F { G { }, H }\n}\n"
    )
    snapshot = capture(write(tmp_path / "repo", {"p/A.java": source}))
    full = derive(snapshot, "r")
    ((key, good),) = full.facts["java"].items()
    size = len(snapshot.files[0].data)
    rejected = 0
    for at in _paths(good):
        for bad in BAD:
            entry = _replace(good, at, bad)
            try:
                java.decode(entry, size)
            except ValueError:
                rejected += 1
                result = derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}})
                assert result == full and result.reused == 0, (at, bad)
                continue
            # Well-formed facts parse could have produced: they may differ, never fail.
            validate(derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}}))
    assert rejected > len(_paths(good)) * len(BAD) // 2


def test_persisted_incremental_equals_full_rebuild(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path / "repo",
        {
            "a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n",
            "b/B.java": "package b;\nimport a.A;\nclass B { void b() { A.go(); } }\n",
        },
    )
    steps: list[dict[str, str | bytes | None]] = [
        {"a/More.java": "package a;\nclass More extends A { void more() { go(); } }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go(int x) {} }\n"},
        {"a/More.java": None, "b/BTest.java": "package b;\nclass BTest { @Test void t() {} }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package renamed;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n"},
    ]
    with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / "incremental") as repo:
        repo.index()
        for i, edits in enumerate(steps):
            apply(root, edits)
            report = repo.index()
            assert report.reused >= 1
            with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / f"full-{i}") as fresh:
                fresh.index()
                assert dump(repo) == dump(fresh)

def test_scoping_is_conservative(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "p/T.java": "package p;\nclass T {\n"
                "  static void f() {}\n  void g() {}\n  void g(int a, int b) {}\n"
                "  void shadow(Object T) { T.f(); }\n"  # a variable obscures the type
                "  <U extends T> void generic(U x) { x.g(); }\n"  # a type parameter
                "  void lambda() { java.util.function.Consumer<T> c = t -> t.g(); g(); }\n"
                "  void local() { class L { void q() { g(); } } new L(); }\n"
                "  void arity() { g(1); }\n"  # no g(int): unknown, not g()
                "  void loose() { var t = new T(); t.g(); T[] ts = {}; ts[0].g(); }\n"
                "  void hash() { hashCode(); toString(); }\n"
                "  class In { void g(String s) {} void h() { g(); } }\n"
                "  static class Up extends T { void h() { g(); super.g(); f(); } }\n"
                "}\n",
            },
        )
    )
    t = "symbol:p/T.java#T"
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.shadow")
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.generic")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.lambda") == {f"{t}.g"}  # t is untyped: t.g opaque
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.local") == {"new L", "g"}  # a local class
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.arity")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.loose") == {t}  # var and arrays carry no type
    assert unresolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.hash") == {"hashCode", "toString"}
    # The innermost class declaring the name decides, even when no overload fits.
    assert not resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.In.h")
    assert resolved(found, "calls", f"{t}.Up.h") == {f"{t}.g", f"{t}.f"}  # inherited


def test_type_lookup_precedence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    found = derived(
        write(
            tmp_path,
            {
                "a/Box.java": "package a;\npublic class Box { public static class In {} }\n",
                "b/Box.java": "package b;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Box.java": "package c;\npublic class Box {}\n",
                "c/Use.java": "package c;\nimport a.Box;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Use { Box single; a.Box.In nested; }\n",
                "c/Demand.java": "package c;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box pkg; }\n",
                "d/Demand.java": "package d;\nimport a.*;\nimport b.*;\n"
                "class Demand { Box two; }\n",
                "d/Ext.java": "package d;\nimport x.Box;\nclass Ext { Box external; }\n",
                "d/Sub.java": "package d;\nclass Sub extends a.Box { In inherited; }\n",
            },
        )
    )
    refs = {
        e.evidence.path: e.targets
        for e in found.edges
        if e.kind == "references" and e.evidence is not None and e.name == "Box"
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Use.java#Use") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",  # a single-type import shadows the package
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # a qualified name
    }
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:c/Demand.java#Demand") == {
        "symbol:c/Box.java#Box"  # the package beats on-demand imports
    }
    assert refs["d/Demand.java"] == ("symbol:a/Box.java#Box", "symbol:b/Box.java#Box")
    assert refs["d/Ext.java"] == ()  # an external single-type import shadows too
    assert resolved(found, "references", "symbol:d/Sub.java#Sub") == {
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box",
        "symbol:a/Box.java#Box.In",  # an inherited member type
    }

def test_coverage_cache_validation_and_limits(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path,
        {
            "Ok.java": "class Ok { void ok() {} }\n",
            "Broken.java": "class Broken { void broken( { return; }\n void after() {} }\n",
            "Latin.java": b"class Latin { } // \xff\n",
        },
    )
    full = derived(root)
    files = {f.path: f for f in full.files}
    assert files["Broken.java"].coverage == "partial" and files["Broken.java"].diagnostics
    assert files["Latin.java"].coverage == "unsupported"
    assert "symbol:Broken.java#Broken" in {e.key for e in full.entities}
    assert set(full.facts) == {"java"}
    for f in capture(root).files:
        parsed = java.parse(f.data)
        if not isinstance(parsed, str):
            assert java.decode(json.loads(json.dumps(java.encode(parsed))), len(f.data)) == parsed
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", full.facts).reused == 2
    cached = copy.deepcopy(full.facts)
    for key in cached["java"]:
        cached["java"][key] = ["damaged"]
    assert derive(capture(root), "test-repo", cached) == full
    deep = ("class P { int x = " + "(" * 70000 + "1" + ")" * 70000 + "; }\n").encode()
    assert java.parse(deep) == python.TOO_DEEP


def test_unsound_cached_facts_are_parsed_never_trusted_or_fatal(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source = (
        "package p;\nimport static q.R.s;\nimport q.*;\n"
        "class A<T> extends B implements C {\n  int n = 1;\n"
        "  void m(D d, int... xs) { d.go(1); this.m(d); new E() { void r() {} }; }\n"
        "  @Test void t() {}\n  enum F { G { }, H }\n}\n"
    )
    snapshot = capture(write(tmp_path / "repo", {"p/A.java": source}))
    full = derive(snapshot, "r")
    ((key, good),) = full.facts["java"].items()
    size = len(snapshot.files[0].data)
    rejected = 0
    for at in _paths(good):
        for bad in BAD:
            entry = _replace(good, at, bad)
            try:
                java.decode(entry, size)
            except ValueError:
                rejected += 1
                result = derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}})
                assert result == full and result.reused == 0, (at, bad)
                continue
            # Well-formed facts parse could have produced: they may differ, never fail.
            validate(derive(snapshot, "r", {"java": {key: entry}}))
    assert rejected > len(_paths(good)) * len(BAD) // 2


def test_persisted_incremental_equals_full_rebuild(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = write(
        tmp_path / "repo",
        {
            "a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n",
            "b/B.java": "package b;\nimport a.A;\nclass B { void b() { A.go(); } }\n",
        },
    )
    steps: list[dict[str, str | bytes | None]] = [
        {"a/More.java": "package a;\nclass More extends A { void more() { go(); } }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package a;\npublic class A { public static void go(int x) {} }\n"},
        {"a/More.java": None, "b/BTest.java": "package b;\nclass BTest { @Test void t() {} }\n"},
        {"a/A.java": "package renamed;\npublic class A { public static void go() {} }\n"},
    ]
    with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / "incremental") as repo:
        repo.index()
        for i, edits in enumerate(steps):
            apply(root, edits)
            report = repo.index()
            assert report.reused >= 1
            with oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=tmp_path / f"full-{i}") as fresh:
                fresh.index()
                assert dump(repo) == dump(fresh)

# typescript-v11: `oxide-python-v6` identity amendment

The `python` component moves to `oxide-python-v6` (facts `oxide-python-facts-v4`), which
narrows the attribute-shadowing rule of Python method dispatch. The graph change and its
evidence are in [../graph-navigation-v2/README.md](../graph-navigation-v2/README.md).
The derivation id hashes every component version, so every index's id changes. The
TypeScript, JavaScript, Go and Rust slices and their facts encodings are unchanged.

## Measured against typescript-v10

| File | Difference from v10 |
| --- | --- |
| `metrics.json` | byte-identical |
| `results.json` | 89 differences, all `versions.derivation` |
| `manifest.json` | 82 corpus `derivation` ids, `versions.derivation`, `oxide_source`. The `baseline`/`protocol` labels are fixed strings and unchanged, as in v10 |

This is an identity amendment, not a quality change.

`performance.json` is re-measured:
- `index_s` is 0.30–0.57× v10's (median 0.47×) on all 82 corpora;
- `max_rss_mb` moves by −2 to +1 MB.

The speed-up is the machine, not the code. v10 was measured on battery in the
`powersave` profile; this run was on AC power, under the 200% CPU cap. Like-for-like
index time for this change is in
[../graph-navigation-v2/README.md](../graph-navigation-v2/README.md) § Acceptance checks
(+0.2% to +4.9% on five Python corpora, the same session).

# Java source support

`oxide-java-v1` adds Java as a language slice of the existing engine:
`core/languages/java.py` extracts syntax facts with `tree-sitter-java==0.23.5`, and
`core/languages/java_resolve.py` resolves them over the whole capture. No JDK, `javac`,
build tool (Maven, Gradle), dependency download or repository code runs during
indexing or querying. The ordinary Python API, CLI, retrieval, graph, router and context
packer serve these files unchanged, and MCP remains exactly one tool, `oxide_search`,
with `search` and `context` modes.

## Extraction and identity

`.java` files report `FileInfo.language == "java"`. Declared types and their members
become symbols, nested as written:

| Java declaration | Kind | Key segment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class C` | `class` | `C` |
| `interface I` | `interface` | `I` |
| `enum E` | `enum` | `E` |
| `record R(...)` | `record` | `R` |
| `@interface A` | `annotation` | `A` |
| a method, abstract or interface method, or annotation element of `C` | `method` | `C.m` |
| a constructor of `C`, compact canonical constructors included | `constructor` | `C.C` |
| a member type `N` of `C` | its kind | `C.N` |

Keys are `symbol:<path>#<segment>`. A member's physical parent is its type, and a
top-level type's is the file. Overloads and other equal segments take `~n` in source
order (`Store.put`, `Store.put~1`), and members nest under the ordinal'd segment.
Entity names are the plain identifiers. Not symbols: fields, enum constants, initializer
blocks, local classes (declared in a method body) and anonymous classes. Their code
stays in the enclosing symbol, and calls inside them come from it.

A declaration's range is its tree-sitter node: modifiers and annotations included,
Javadoc excluded. Its signature is the header up to the body, without annotations, with
whitespace collapsed (`public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend`,
`public String get(Key key)`, `int seconds() default 60`).

A package is every `.java` file with the same package declaration, wherever its
directory: `module:java:<package>`, named by the package, so `src/main/java` and
`src/test/java` halves of one package are one module. Modules `contain_logical` their
files and `define` their top-level types. Default-package files form one package per
directory for resolution and have no module.

Test methods are methods annotated `@Test`, `@ParameterizedTest`, `@RepeatedTest`,
`@TestFactory` or `@TestTemplate`, matched by simple name, so the annotations of JUnit 4,
JUnit 5 and TestNG all count, qualified or not. A resolved call made inside a test,
including its lambdas and anonymous classes, adds `tested_by`, the same heuristic as the
other slices.

## Resolution

Everything below follows the Java Language Specification's scoping and javac's
compile-time lookup, applied to the captured source only. Nothing runs a type checker.
A lookup that would need one, or that reaches code outside the capture, is unresolved
rather than guessed.

- **Types.** A simple type name resolves in javac's order: type parameters and local
  classes, which are opaque; member types of the enclosing classes, innermost first,
  including types inherited from captured supertypes; then the file's own top-level
  types, single-type imports, types of the same package and on-demand imports. A
  single-type import of something not captured (`import java.util.List;`) still shadows
  the package, so the name is unresolved. Several on-demand imports offering a name
  are ambiguous. A qualified name (`a.b.Box.In`) resolves through its longest captured
  package prefix, or through a type and its member types.
- **Imports.** Each import is an `imports` edge from its file to what it names: the type
  of a single-type import, the package's module (or the type) of an on-demand import, and
  for a static import the methods and member types of that name (every overload, so an
  overloaded name is ambiguous), or the owner type for a field.
- **Methods.** A call `m(...)` resolves to the innermost enclosing class that has a
  member method `m`. Its members are the methods it declares plus those inherited
  through captured supertypes, the nearest declaring type first. Then come
  single-static-imported and static-on-demand-imported methods. Overloads are filtered
  by argument count; varargs methods accept their arity minus one or more. Several

`.java` files report `FileInfo.language == "java"`. Declared types and their members
become symbols, nested as written:

| a constructor of `C`, compact canonical constructors included | `constructor` | `C.C` |
| a member type `N` of `C` | its kind | `C.N` |

Keys are `symbol:<path>#<segment>`. A member's physical parent is its type, and a
top-level type's is the file. Overloads and other equal segments take `~n` in source
order (`Store.put`, `Store.put~1`), and members nest under the ordinal'd segment.
Entity names are the plain identifiers. Not symbols: fields, enum constants, initializer
blocks, local classes (declared in a method body) and anonymous classes. Their code
stays in the enclosing symbol, and calls inside them come from it.

A declaration's range is its tree-sitter node: modifiers and annotations included,
Javadoc excluded. Its signature is the header up to the body, without annotations, with

compile-time lookup, applied to the captured source only. Nothing runs a type checker.

rather than guessed.

  classes, which are opaque; member types of the enclosing classes, innermost first,

# Java source support

`oxide-java-v1` adds Java as a language slice of the existing engine:
`core/languages/java.py` extracts syntax facts with `tree-sitter-java==0.23.5`, and

build tool (Maven, Gradle), dependency download or repository code runs during
indexing or querying. The ordinary Python API, CLI, retrieval, graph, router and context
packer serve these files unchanged, and MCP remains exactly one tool, `oxide_search`,
with `search` and `context` modes.

## Extraction and identity

`.java` files report `FileInfo.language == "java"`. Declared types and their members
become symbols, nested as written:

| Java declaration | Kind | Key segment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class C` | `class` | `C` |
| `interface I` | `interface` | `I` |
| `enum E` | `enum` | `E` |
| `record R(...)` | `record` | `R` |
| `@interface A` | `annotation` | `A` |
| a method, abstract or interface method, or annotation element of `C` | `method` | `C.m` |
| a constructor of `C`, compact canonical constructors included | `constructor` | `C.C` |
| a member type `N` of `C` | its kind | `C.N` |

Keys are `symbol:<path>#<segment>`. A member's physical parent is its type, and a
top-level type's is the file. Overloads and other equal segments take `~n` in source
order (`Store.put`, `Store.put~1`), and members nest under the ordinal'd segment.
Entity names are the plain identifiers. Not symbols: fields, enum constants, initializer
blocks, local classes (declared in a method body) and anonymous classes. Their code
stays in the enclosing symbol, and calls inside them come from it.

A declaration's range is its tree-sitter node: modifiers and annotations included,
Javadoc excluded. Its signature is the header up to the body, without annotations, with
whitespace collapsed (`public class Store extends AbstractStore implements Backend`,
`public String get(Key key)`, `int seconds() default 60`).

A package is every `.java` file with the same package declaration, wherever its
directory: `module:java:<package>`, named by the package, so `src/main/java` and
`src/test/java` halves of one package are one module. Modules `contain_logical` their
files and `define` their top-level types. Default-package files form one package per
directory for resolution and have no module.

`@TestFactory` or `@TestTemplate`, matched by simple name, so the annotations of JUnit 4,
JUnit 5 and TestNG all count, qualified or not. A resolved call made inside a test,
including its lambdas and anonymous classes, adds `tested_by`, the same heuristic as the
other slices.

"""Bounded Go milestone evidence (docs/phase-6/go-v1), without running repository code.

rows PARQUET OUT: the Go tasks of the SHA-checked ContextBench full.parquet selected
  by the rule fixed before scoring (``select``).
fetch ROWS DIR: a ``git archive`` projection of .go and go.mod files per base commit.
context ROWS CORPORA OUT: audit gold, then score with the unchanged ContextBench scorer.
real ROOT OUT: coverage, resolutions, facts parity and persisted edit/rebuild parity.
audit ROOT OUT: SHA-selected resolved cross-file calls and imports, for inspection.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import resource
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tests/python"))
import contextbench as cb
import contextbench_ts as ts
import eval_javascript as ej
import tree_sitter_go
from tree_sitter import Language, Parser

import oxide
from oxide.capture import capture

PER_REPOSITORY = 3
MAX_FILES = 7500
LANGUAGE = Language(tree_sitter_go.language())
DECLARATIONS = ("function_declaration", "method_declaration", "type_declaration")


def select(rows: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    """The first three Go rows per repository by original instance id whose gold names
    a .go file. Fixed before any scoring; no other filter."""
    chosen: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    taken: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: str(r["original_inst_id"])):
        gold = json.loads(str(row["gold_context"]))
        if row["language"] != "go" or not any(g["file"].endswith(".go") for g in gold):
            continue
        if taken[str(row["repo"])] < PER_REPOSITORY:
            taken[str(row["repo"])] += 1
            chosen.append(row)
    return chosen


def keep(name: str) -> bool:
    return name.endswith(".go") or Path(name).name in ("go.mod", "go.work")


def module_lines(data: bytes) -> set[int]:
    """Lines outside the outermost func, method and type declarations: the scorer's own
    view through the grammar, independent of OXIDE's derivation."""
    root = Parser(LANGUAGE).parse(data).root_node
    inside = {
        n
        for node in root.named_children
        if node.type in DECLARATIONS
        for n in range(node.start_point[0] + 1, node.end_point[0] + 2)
    }
    return set(range(1, data.count(b"\n") + 2)) - inside


class Lines(cb.Lines):
    def module(self, path: str) -> set[int]:
        if not path.endswith(".go"):
            return super().module(path)
        if path not in self.modules:
            try:
                self.modules[path] = module_lines(self.file(path))
            except OSError:
                self.modules[path] = set()
        return self.modules[path]


def corpus(row: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    return str(row["repo"]).replace("/", "__") + "@" + str(row["base_commit"])[:12]


def context(rows_path: Path, corpora: Path, out: Path) -> None:
    rows = json.loads(rows_path.read_text())
    results, audits, identities, times = [], {}, {}, {}
    for row in rows:
        root = corpora / corpus(row)
        files = sum(1 for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
        assert files <= MAX_FILES, f"{root}: {files} files"
        gold, verdicts = [], []
        for g in json.loads(row["gold_context"]):
            if not g["file"].endswith(".go"):
                continue
            content, numbered = ts.unnumbered(g["content"], g["start_line"])
            start, end = g["start_line"], g["end_line"]
            verdict = cb.classify(root, g["file"], start, end, content, row["patch"])
            verdicts.append(verdict | {"numbered": numbered})
            gold.append(
                {
                    "file": verdict.get("corrected_file", g["file"]),
                    "start": start,
                    "end": end,
                    "sha256": cb._sha(cb.normalized(g["content"])),
                    "class": verdict["class"],
                    "verified": verdict["class"] in cb.VERIFIED,
                }
            )
        task = {
            "id": row["original_inst_id"],
            "split": "heldout",
            "corpus": corpus(row),
            "query": row["problem_statement"],
            "symbols": [],
            "gold": gold,
        }
        audits[task["id"]] = verdicts
        with (
            tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="oxide-contextbench-go-") as temporary,
            oxide.open_repository(root, data_dir=Path(temporary)) as repo,
        ):
            report = repo.index()
            started = time.perf_counter()
            result = cb.score(repo, Lines(root), task)
            assert all(
                b["within_budget"] and b["deterministic"] for b in result["bundles"].values()
            )
            results.append(result)
            times[task["id"]] = {
                "index_s": report.seconds,
                "score_s": time.perf_counter() - started,
            }
            identities[task["corpus"]] = {
                "snapshot": report.snapshot.snapshot_id,
                "commit": row["base_commit"],
                "files": report.files,
                "entities": report.entities,
                "relations": report.relations,
                "partial": list(report.partial),
            }
    ej.save(out / "results.json", results)
    ej.save(out / "metrics.json", cb.aggregate(results))
    ej.save(out / "gold-audit.json", audits)
    ej.save(
        out / "manifest.json",
        {
            "source_sha256": cb.PARQUET_SHA256,
            "rows_sha256": hashlib.sha256(rows_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "selection": [r["original_inst_id"] for r in rows],
            "corpora": identities,
            "budgets": cb.BUDGETS,
            "scorer": "contextbench-py-scorer with Go module projection v1",
        },
    )
    ej.save(
        out / "performance.json",
        {"tasks": times, "peak_rss_mib": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1024},
    )


def audit(root: Path, out: Path) -> None:
    """Ten resolved cross-file calls and ten resolved imports, chosen by the SHA-256 of
    their evidence, with the caller's text and the target's signature."""
    from oxide.core.indexing import derive

    snap = capture(root)
    data = {f.path: f.data for f in snap.files}
    full = derive(snap, "evaluation")
    entities = {e.key: e for e in full.entities}
    samples = {}
    for kind in ("calls", "imports"):
        edges = [
            (hashlib.sha256(repr(e).encode()).hexdigest(), e, e.evidence)
            for e in full.edges
            if e.kind == kind
            and e.resolution == "resolved"
            and e.evidence is not None
            and e.evidence.path.endswith(".go")
            and not e.targets[0].startswith(f"symbol:{e.evidence.path}#")
        ]
        samples[kind] = [
            {
                "source": e.source,
                "target": e.targets[0],
                "text": data[at.path][at.start : at.end].decode(),
                "target_name": entities[e.targets[0]].name,
                "target_signature": entities[e.targets[0]].signature,
            }
            for _, e, at in sorted(edges, key=lambda t: t[0])[:10]
            if at is not None
        ]
    ej.save(out, samples)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="mode", required=True)
    for mode, names in (
        ("rows", ("parquet", "out")),
        ("fetch", ("rows", "directory")),
        ("context", ("rows", "corpora", "out")),
        ("real", ("root", "out")),
        ("audit", ("root", "out")),
    ):
        mode_parser = sub.add_parser(mode)
        for name in names:
            mode_parser.add_argument(name, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "rows":
        ej.save(args.out, select(cb._parquet(args.parquet)))
    elif args.mode == "fetch":
        ej.fetch(args.rows, args.directory, keep)
    elif args.mode == "context":
        context(args.rows, args.corpora, args.out)
    elif args.mode == "real":
        ej.real(args.root, args.out, "go")
    else:
        audit(args.root, args.out)
